purpose: Orderly storage and retention for runtime temp files, workspaces, backups, logs, and durable records; delete only unimportant disposable content and keep every important record in a structured local layout.

storage_layout..runtime/tmp: disposable validation fixtures and scratch; deleted after retention
storage_layout..runtime/work: candidate clones and generated workspaces; kept until review, stale candidates advisory only
storage_layout..codex/project/timing-analysis: timing analysis and session timing ledgers (protected)
storage_layout..codex/project/iteration-runs: iteration logs; old logs pruned to the latest N
storage_layout..codex/project/*-codex-backups: pre-iteration rollback snapshots; keep the latest N

deletion_rule: At a verified task-end boundary, delete only disposable tmp items older than retention and prune old backup snapshots and iteration logs beyond the keep-latest window. Durable sessions, memory, timing evidence, archives, reports, proofs, gates, envelopes, and rollback backups are never auto-deleted; stale workspaces are advisory only.
rollback_note: Pruning old pre-iteration snapshots is safe after a verified iteration because the latest snapshot, release-backups, and Git refs preserve rollback evidence.
